notes.body:
Physiologically based pharmacokinetic/ pharmacodynamic (PBPK/PD) model of dapagliflozin
Dapagliflozin is an SGLT2 inhibitor prescribed for the management of type 2 diabetes mellitus. The drug lowers blood glucose levels by increasing urinary glucose excretion. Despite established efficacy, dapagliflozin demonstrates significant inter-individual variability in pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, with potential impact on treatment outcomes. To evaluate the sources of variability, we developed a digital twin of dapagliflozin pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics built as a PBPK/PD model using curated data from 28 clinical studies. This constitutes a full mechanistic model that integrates absorption, metabolism, excretion, and pharmacodynamics. It accounts for key determinants of variability including renal and hepatic function, and food effects.
Substances:
dap: dapagliflozin
d3g: dapagliflozin-3-O-glucuronide (D3G, about 61 % of an oral dose in the urine [Obermeier2010]), formed by UGT1A9 in liver and kidney
dapmet: the other metabolites, the 2-O-glucuronide (about 5 %) and the oxidative metabolites (about 10 %) [Obermeier2010, Callegari2021], lumped into one metabolite
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

parameter.name: rate of the hepatic metabolism of dapagliflozin

body.p: First-order rate of the hepatic metabolism of dapagliflozin, relative to the volume of the liver tissue (LI__DAPMET_k of the liver). Dapagliflozin is far below the Km of UGT1A9 (479 µM [Kasichayanula2013]), its pharmacokinetics are dose proportional from 0.1 to 500 mg [Komoroski2009]. The renal metabolism is f_met_renal of the metabolism of both organs. The clearance of an intravenous microdose is 207 ml/min [Boulton2013].
The value of DAPMET_k is the result of the fit PK_20261020_002954__89bab, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

Fraction of the metabolism of dapagliflozin in the kidney at normal renal and hepatic function, the rest is hepatic. The split is not identified by the data of healthy subjects; it is set from the AUC ratios of renal impairment (1.60, 2.07, 1.95 [Kasichayanula2013], which need about 0.68) and of hepatic impairment (1.03, 1.36, 1.67 [Kasichayanula2011], which need about 0.4-0.68), validation data both. The kidney has 8-fold the UGT1A9 mRNA and 3-fold the D3G formation per mg microsomal protein of the liver [Kasichayanula2013].

parameter.name: rate of the renal metabolism of dapagliflozin

body.p: First-order rate of the renal metabolism relative to the volume of the kidney (KI__DAPMET_k of the kidney), from the hepatic rate and the renal fraction f_met_renal.

body.p: Fraction of the metabolism of dapagliflozin (liver and kidney) which forms D3G, the rest forms the other metabolites (dapmet). Ratio of the slow pool to the fast pool of the rest tissue in the equilibrium: the part of the volume of distribution which is reached slowly and sets the terminal phase.

parameter.name: rate of the slow pool dap (rest)

body.p: The exchange with the slow pool of the rest tissue: the concentrations fall fast in the first 12 hr after a dose (distribution into the fast pool, metabolism) and with a half-life of 12-13 hr after it [Boulton2013, Komoroski2009].

blockquote.p: 1.0: increased kidney function 1.0: normal kidney function (healthy control) <1.0: decreased kidney function Renal function relative to the healthy glomerular filtration rate GFR_base, which is 101 ml/min at 75 kg; a measured creatinine clearance or GFR of X ml/min is the renal function X/101. It scales the filtration (renal excretion, glucose excretion) and the renal metabolism (the functional renal mass).

body.p: Dapagliflozin is 91 % bound to plasma proteins [Obermeier2010] (92.3-93 % [Kasichayanula2013]), independent of the renal and hepatic function.

parameter.name: renal clearance of dapagliflozin relative to its filtration

body.p: The renal clearance of dapagliflozin is DAPEX_f times the filtration of its unbound fraction, fu_dap * GFR (9 ml/min). The renal clearance of 3.5-5.6 ml/min [Kasichayanula2013, Obermeier2010] is about half of the filtration: net tubular reabsorption.
The value of KI__DAPEX_f is the result of the fit PK_20261020_002954__89bab, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: renal clearance of the metabolites relative to the GFR

body.p: The renal clearance of D3G is D3GEX_f times the GFR: 151 ml/min in healthy subjects [Kasichayanula2013], above the GFR (tubular secretion, D3G is an OAT3 substrate). The other metabolites (the 2-O-glucuronide and the oxidative metabolites) are excreted in the same way. The plasma kinetics of the metabolites are limited by their formation.
The value of KI__D3GEX_f is the result of the fit PK_20261020_002954__89bab, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: mean plasma glucose of the day minus the fasting plasma glucose

body.p: The glucose which is filtered over the day is the mean plasma glucose of the day, above the fasting plasma glucose by the meals. In healthy subjects about 0.85 mM: the urinary glucose excretion of 285 mmol/day over a GFR of 139 l/day with a 24-hr mean RTG of 3.79 mM is a mean plasma glucose of 5.85 mM [Sha2015]. Studies which report the 24-hr mean plasma glucose set the difference to the FPG.

EC50 of the reduction of the RTG by plasma dapagliflozin (total). The IC50 of dapagliflozin for human SGLT2 is about 1.1 nM (unbound), about 5 ng/ml (1.2e-5 mM) total with fu 0.09; SGLT2 is inhibited from the tubular lumen. The urinary glucose excretion rises steeply from 0.3 mg (0.6 g/24 hr) to 1 mg (19 g/24 hr) [Gould2013].
The value of KI__RTG_E50 is the result of the fit PD_20261020_014612__f2826, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

The steepness of the reduction of the RTG with the concentration, at least 1 (an exponent below 1 makes the integration stiff at zero dapagliflozin). With an exponent of 1 the fits give the steep dose response from 0.3 to 2.5 mg only with an RTG at the upper bound of its range (14 mM, PD_20261020_010757__2bd20).

RTG without SGLT2 inhibition in healthy subjects (FPG 5 mM), which corresponds to the SGLT2 capacity; about 10-11 mM (180-200 mg/dl). Not fitted: the urinary glucose of the fits bounds it only from below (10 mM, PD_20261020_012618__f9531).

Increase of the RTG per mM of FPG above the healthy FPG: SGLT2 is induced in type 2 diabetes [Rahmoune2005]. Phenomenological: it gives the urinary glucose excretion of type 2 diabetes (38-77 g with 2.5-20 mg [Kasichayanula2011a, FDAMB102003]) with the constant glucose of the model, which has no fall of the glucose during the treatment.
The value of KI__RTG_m_fpg is the result of the fit PD_20261020_014612__f2826, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: maximal relative reduction of the RTG

body.p: Maximal reduction of the RTG by SGLT2 inhibition relative to the RTG without inhibition: SGLT1 reabsorbs the glucose which SGLT2 does not; the RTG under full inhibition is about 2-4 mM.
The value of KI__RTG_max_inhibition is the result of the fit PD_20261020_014612__f2826, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: splay of the glucose excretion around the RTG

body.p: The thresholds of the nephrons differ, so the glucose excretion rises smoothly around the RTG (splay) instead of at a sharp threshold; the softplus with a width of 1 mM.

parameter.name: mean plasma glucose of the day

body.p: Fraction absorbed: F_dap_abs of the dapagliflozin of the intestinal lumen is absorbed, (1 - F_dap_abs) is excreted in the feces. 15.4 % of an oral dose is excreted unchanged in the feces [Obermeier2010]; with the hepatic first pass the bioavailability is 0.78 [Boulton2013]. Not fitted: only the feces of Obermeier2010 identify it.
First-order rate of the dapagliflozin leaving the lumen, absorbed (F_dap_abs) or to the feces: tmax 1.0-1.25 hr fasted [Boulton2013, Kasichayanula2013].
The value of GU__DAPABS_k is the result of the fit PK_20261020_002954__89bab, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

The dose is taken in the fasted state (0) or with a meal (1). The effect of food on the absorption rate is FED_f_absorption.

parameter.name: fed effect on the absorption rate

body.p: Factor of the absorption rate with food: a high fat meal lowers Cmax by 31 % (10 mg) and delays tmax by about 1 hr, the AUC is unchanged [Kasichayanula2011b]; Cmax -45 to -51 % with 2.5 mg [LaCreta2016]. The fraction absorbed is not changed.
The value of GU__FED_f_absorption is the result of the fit PK_20261020_002954__89bab, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

assignmentRule.name: mean plasma glucose of the day

body.p: The glucose which is filtered.
FPG dependent RTG without SGLT2 inhibition. SGLT2 is induced in T2DM [Rahmoune2005].
Renal threshold glucose.

The renal threshold for glucose (RTG) is the plasma glucose concentration at which the tubular reabsorption of glucose begins to saturate; glucose is excreted into the urine in proportion to the glucose concentration above this threshold.
Urinary glucose excretion, the cumulative amount of glucose in the urine.

body.p: The glucuronidation of the dapagliflozin of the renal plasma to D3G by UGT1A9; uptake and export are fast. It scales with the renal function (the functional renal mass).
The minor pathways of the renal metabolism of dapagliflozin (2-O-glucuronide by UGT2B7), lumped into one metabolite.
The filtered glucose above the RTG, the softplus of the difference with the width RTG_splay: the excretion approaches GFR * (pg - RTG) above the RTG and zero below it.
Uptake of the dapagliflozin of the plasma of the liver and its glucuronidation to D3G by UGT1A9; the export of D3G into the plasma is fast.
The minor pathways of the metabolism of dapagliflozin, the 2-O-glucuronide (UGT2B4/2B7) and the oxidative metabolites (CYP3A4), lumped into one metabolite.
Swallowing, dissolution of tablet, and transport into intestine. Overall process describing the rates of this processes.
